content.rendered:
Since you are redesigning or building a new web project, these under construction website templates will be exceptionally handy.

We went on a hunt to collect multiple designs you can now use and reuse as many times as you want.

BUT.

We decided to put the main focus of this collection on free templates. Why?

Since an under construction page is more of a quick fix (which you can use strategically for collecting leads), a free tool will do the trick easily.

Not to mention, the ones we managed to pick are more premium than anything else.

That’s it! Announce that something bigger and better is coming with style.

Best Under Construction Website Templates

1. Hintio (Premium)


Hintio is a very serious deal with its combination of coming soon and landing page templates. Of course, you can comfortably use it to create an under construction page, too.

This tool is designed with a creative touch and includes many great features, such as an animated background, a swiper slider, a MailChimp subscription form, and a countdown timer.

With the four core sections, you can display about, portfolio, contact, location and more. You can easily tweak things, add your branding and make Hintio match your web project to a tee.

Con: We wish the author would update it more frequently.

Download Preview

2. Balti (Premium)


Balti is our second favorite premium under construction website template. With a whopping 38 templates, Balti delivers heaps of material that you can use to work on one or ten upcoming pages.

With easy customizations, you unlock even more options and possibilities. Balti’s code is lightweight and well-structured, perfect for beginners and great for experts. You also get documentation and six months’ worth of free access to support.

With eight background styles, you can make things either extremely minimal or go fancy with different effects. Last but not least, you also get Ajax subscription and contact forms.

Download Preview

3. Oomph (Premium)


Even though it may not be placed on the first spot, Oomph is secretly my personal favorite. It’s simple, clean but modern and creative.

Oomph provides twelve samples, three color skins, and four content sections—more than enough for an under-construction website template.

However, Oomph rocks even more, so you can create a truly impressive page. If you are announcing something huge, you need to announce it like a boss.

And especially if you also plan to collect leads with Oomph – make it attention-grabbing. Which, of course, you will with Oomph!

Download Preview

4. Coming Soon V01


Okay, we’re now all about the free under-construction templates. Coming Soon V01 is a creative one, but not too creative. Or minimal, but not too minimal. Does that make sense?

Using Bootstrap, the beautiful layout smoothly reshapes to different screen sizes. It goes from horizontal on desktop to vertical on mobile. (You may need to try it first to notice the difference.)

Download Preview

5. Coming Soon V03


The wide variety of different under construction/coming soon pages makes it easy picking the right one for your project.

Coming Soon V03 is an excellent example with a boxy look, a countdown timer, and a newsletter subscription form. You can add your logo and some extra text to let the user know what’s happening and what to expect shortly.

Make it exciting with Coming Soon V03!

Download Preview

6. Coming Soon V04


Coming Soon V04 is very minimal but the gradient background effect spices thing up. Remember, you can tweak it, even changing the background color. You are welcome to use everything else as-is.

What’s cool about Coming Soon V04 is the newsletter pop-up that appears after clicking the “follow us” button. The only thing I’d wished is that the countdown timer would get slightly smaller on mobile, so the numbers would be in line.

Download Preview

7. Coming Soon V07


For everyone who likes the gradient effect but finds the previous template too minimal, here’s Coming Soon V07. It features a background image, social media icons, text, form, and countdown timer.

It features all the necessities to integrate it into your web project quickly without making too many improvements to tailor it to your needs.

Download Preview

8. Coming Soon V09


Coming Soon V09 may not seem special at first glance. Wait for it! The entire background appears as a slideshow, which makes things special. We also like the font choice and bold numbers.

Moreover, Coming Soon V09 lets you link your under construction page to your favorite social media profiles. It comes with Facebook, Twitter and YouTube icons by default.

Download Preview

9. Coming Soon V10


Would you like another free under-construction website template with a background slider? You’re in luck, as Coming Soon V10 is just that, but it’s different from the previous one.

The more options, the better! And that’s what this list delivers.

The vertical countdown timer on the desktop is also cool about Coming Soon V10. Do you know what would make this free design truly extraordinary? If it already comes with a newsletter/sign-up/login pop-up by default (after clicking the “sign-up” button).

Download Preview

10. Coming Soon V12


Coming Soon V12 has a nice split-screen layout that will make your under-construction page pop. But it’s not just any split design.

The right section with the image is a slider. How cool is that? To make things even more engaging, you can include any images you want.

There’s no countdown timer in this case, but Coming Soon V12 does come with a predefined lead form with autofill.

Download Preview

11. Coming Soon V13


Yes, sliders are popular, so we’re adding another under construction website template that does things correctly. Coming Soon V13 rocks a background slideshow with a countdown timer at the top and email opt-in at the bottom of the page.

Moreover, you also see a preset play button, which you can use to include a pop-up video (but you’d need to code that yourself). Or you can simply delete it if you don’t need it.

Download Preview

12. Coming Soon V14


Regarding the under construction page, it’s entirely up to you whether you’d like to pay any special attention to it or not. If you’re unsure about the design, Coming Soon V14 is between basic/minimal and creative/fancy.

You can add an image, social links, and an opt-in form that requires just the email address. Coming Soon V14 also keeps things simple without a countdown timer. The user needs to sign-up to receive the updates.

Download Preview

13. Coming Soon V16


Immediately you get a fancier option for your under construction/coming soon section with Coming Soon V16.

While I won’t describe what’s hot about Coming Soon V16, I’ll mention the special countdown timer. It features a circular progress bar, which you don’t see daily.

Con: I would work on the mobile version some more, reducing the size of each section, so they don’t cover an entire screen.

Download Preview

14. Coming Soon V19


This is something I am looking forward to it very much. Coming Soon V19 is a dark under construction website template. Any fans of dark/black designs out there?

You now don’t need to create such a page from scratch, as you can download Coming Soon V19 free of charge.

The split layout features image on the left and text, form and social buttons on the right. The core is easy to work with since Coming Soon V19 features a beginner-friendly code.

Download Preview

Additional Free Coming Soon Templates

We’ve expanded our collection with these additional high-quality coming soon templates from Colorlib. Each template offers unique design approaches and features to help you create the perfect pre-launch page for your website.

15. Coming Soon V02

Coming Soon V02 delivers a sleek, minimalist design with a prominent countdown timer and email subscription form. The template features a clean white background with subtle animations, social media icons, and responsive layout perfect for professional businesses preparing their launch.

Why we like it: The ultra-clean design and focus on essentials make this template perfect for professional services and startups that want to build anticipation without overwhelming visitors.

View Demo Download

16. Coming Soon V05

Coming Soon V05 combines elegant typography with subtle animated backgrounds to create an engaging waiting experience. This template includes countdown functionality, newsletter integration, and smooth scroll animations that keep visitors interested while your site is under development.

Why we like it: The sophisticated animation effects and typography choices create a premium feel that works well for creative agencies and design-focused businesses.

View Demo Download

17. Coming Soon V06

Coming Soon V06 features a modern split-screen layout with bold color combinations and dynamic content areas. The template includes social media integration, countdown timer, and contact information sections, making it ideal for businesses that want to maintain communication during development.

Why we like it: The split-screen design allows for both visual impact and information delivery, perfect for brands that need to convey multiple messages during their pre-launch phase.

View Demo Download

18. Coming Soon V08

Coming Soon V08 stands out with video background support and modern UI elements. This template features a translucent overlay for text readability, countdown timer with custom styling, and integrated subscription forms, creating an immersive pre-launch experience.

Why we like it: The video background capability makes this template excellent for businesses wanting to showcase their products or services visually while building their main website.

View Demo Download

19. Coming Soon V11

Coming Soon V11 incorporates geometric design patterns with gradient backgrounds for a contemporary look. The template includes animated countdown timers, progress bars showing development status, and email capture forms with validation, perfect for tech startups and modern businesses.

Why we like it: The geometric patterns and gradients give this template a cutting-edge feel that resonates with tech-savvy audiences and innovative companies.

View Demo Download

20. Coming Soon V15

Coming Soon V15 offers a striking dark theme with neon accent colors that create visual interest. This template includes animated text effects, social media links with hover animations, and a prominent email subscription section, ideal for entertainment and gaming websites.

Why we like it: The dark theme with neon highlights creates an exciting, modern aesthetic perfect for brands targeting younger demographics or entertainment industries.

View Demo Download

21. Coming Soon V17

Coming Soon V17 features interactive particle animations that respond to mouse movement, creating an engaging user experience. The template includes a clean layout with centered content, countdown timer, and subscription form, suitable for creative and tech companies.

Why we like it: The interactive particle effects add a layer of sophistication and interactivity that keeps visitors engaged while waiting for the full site launch.

View Demo Download

22. Coming Soon V18

Coming Soon V18 implements a full-screen image slider with overlay content areas for maximum visual impact. The template features smooth transitions between slides, integrated countdown functionality, and newsletter signup forms, perfect for portfolio and photography sites.

Why we like it: The image slider functionality allows businesses to showcase multiple aspects of their brand or products even before the main site launches.

View Demo Download

23. Coming Soon V20

Coming Soon V20 prioritizes mobile experience with a touch-friendly interface and responsive design. This template includes swipeable content sections, optimized countdown display for small screens, and simplified subscription forms that work perfectly on mobile devices.

Why we like it: The mobile-first approach ensures excellent user experience across all devices, crucial for modern websites where mobile traffic dominates.

View Demo Download

24. Coming Soon V21

Coming Soon V21 embraces the glassmorphism design trend with frosted glass effects and depth. The template includes blurred backgrounds with translucent elements, modern typography, and smooth animations that create a sophisticated pre-launch presence.

Why we like it: The glassmorphism effects create a modern, trendy aesthetic that shows your brand is current with design trends and attention to detail.

View Demo Download

25. Coming Soon V22

Coming Soon V22 utilizes animated SVG graphics to create unique visual experiences. This template features creative asymmetric layouts, smooth scroll animations, and interactive elements that make the waiting period engaging for visitors exploring your coming soon page.

Why we like it: The SVG animations and creative layout break away from traditional coming soon pages, perfect for brands wanting to make a memorable first impression.

View Demo Download

26. Coming Soon V23

Coming Soon V23 adopts a modern brutalist design approach with bold, oversized typography and high contrast colors. The template includes minimal but impactful animations, clear call-to-action sections, and a no-nonsense approach to pre-launch communication.

Why we like it: The brutalist design makes a strong statement and works excellently for brands that want to convey confidence and boldness from the very start.

View Demo Download
